title: Live Black Soldier Fly Larvae 8 oz cup
description: Give your animals a naturally nutrient-rich treat with live black soldier fly larvae from White Eagle Nutrition. These active feeder larvae are a high-value supplemental treat for chickens, ducks, quail, reptiles, fish, wild birds, and other insect-loving animals. Packed fresh in a ventilated 8 oz container, our live BSFL are easy to feed, easy to store, and naturally appealing to animals that thrive on whole insect nutrition. They provide a rich source of protein, healthy fats, calcium, and natural insect-based compounds that support a varied, species-appropriate diet. Use them as a training reward, enrichment treat, foraging supplement, or occasional high-protein snack. Key Benefits Live feeder larvae for poultry, reptiles, fish, and birds Naturally high in protein, fat, and calcium Great for flock enrichment and natural foraging behavior Whole insect nutrition with no unnecessary fillers Packed in an 8 oz ventilated cup for freshness GROWN IN TEXAS, USA Suggested Use Poultry: Scatter freely as a supplemental treat.Reptiles: Offer as part of a varied diet.Fish: Feed only what can be consumed within 1–2 minutes.Wild Birds: Offer in limited quantities as an occasional treat.
